outcome: Enhanced antiangiogenic circulating profile (soluble endoglin, soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1)
cohort: The study included 204 adults aged 25 years (range, 20-30 years), comprising 102 individuals followed up prospectively since very preterm birth and 102 born term to uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: Preterm-born individuals exhibit an enhanced antiangiogenic state in adult life that is specifically related to elevations in blood pressure, an association which seems to be mediated through capillary rarefaction.
gest_age: Mean 30.3 ± 2.5 weeks for the preterm group; term for the control group.
